instruction: A soft stuffed astronaut with a round fabric helmet, stitched visor, and pudgy mitten hands and boots. Made of quilted white minky fabric with visible seams, a felt chest patch, and puffy padded limbs that pose slightly outward. Embroidered details and a plump huggable body give it the cozy charm of a handmade toy.
